label: preparing
what: A community supper, with bread/grain contributions and coordinated hospitality; possibly linked to the great hall service acknowledgement, although the record leaves the supper's time and venue unconfirmed and does not establish that the mayor was deliberately kept uninformed. Evidence suggests collective preparation, but the connection between the supper and the hall event is uncertain; baker, neighbour, builder, innkeeper, and freight appear involved in overlapping logistics, with innkeeper and freight helping knowingly organize hospitality/donations. The mayor was told about the supper effort, so it is not well supported that this was something he was not told about.
